title: Place order silently fails with 3+ items in cart
goal: Buy 3 different travel passes and complete checkout without assistance
reproSteps: Add 3 different travel passes to the cart
Open checkout, enter a valid email and name, click Continue
Enter card details and click Place order (twice)
Observe: no confirmation, no error message; 500 POST /api/checkout
suspectedCause: Checkout API returns 500 for 3+ items and the client swallows the failure.
suggestedFix: Server: make POST /api/checkout handle multi-item carts. Client: show an error toast on non-OK responses.
regressionCheck: Re-run this journey: order must reach /success and no 500 on /api/checkout.

title: Multiple "Continue" controls do different things; users backtrack
goal: Buy 3 different travel passes and complete checkout without assistance
reproSteps: Observe: user is sent BACK to step 1 instead of forward
suspectedCause: Three controls share the label 'Continue' with different behaviors.
suggestedFix: Relabel by intent: 'Continue to payment' / 'Back to details' / 'Subscribe'.
regressionCheck: No two primary controls share a label; clicking Back never advances.
